description: This file contains multiple data model classes for a site verification and workflow management system, including User, Site, Coordinates, Verification, WorkflowStep, and AuditLog, each with JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents an application user with id, email, and optional name.

classes.name: Site
classes.description: Represents a site with id, name, address, coordinates, status, timestamps, and owner ID.

classes.name: Coordinates
classes.description: Represents geographical coordinates with latitude and longitude.

classes.name: Verification
classes.description: Represents a verification record linked to a site, including status and timestamps.

classes.name: WorkflowStep
classes.description: Represents a workflow step within a process, including status, assigned personnel, due dates, and ordering.

classes.name: AuditLog
classes.description: Represents an audit log entry capturing actor, action, entity details, metadata, and timestamps.

methods.description: Constructs a User instance from a JSON map.

methods.description: Serializes a User instance to a JSON map.
